marketingClaims.claim: TakeoffPro gives your RE team digital measurement tools that produce audit-ready quantity records.
Replace paper DC forms with audit-ready digital records.
It supports the NJTA 7th Edition 2016 Standard Specifications.
GPS-to-Plan georeferencing lets inspectors physically walk a perimeter or line on the job site.
AI-Powered Quantity Extraction — Auto-detect quantities from spec tables and plan notes.
Automated Monthly Estimate Generation — Format quantities into NJDOT DC-84 payment estimate format.
SiteManager / AASHTOWare Integration — Sync quantities with NJDOT's official construction management system.
Pull plan sets directly from your NJTA / NJDOT document management system.
Give contractors read-only access to measured quantities before payment disputes arise.
A contractor portal [is available].
API access is available for enterprise integrations — SiteManager, AASHTOWare, or internal reporting.
Dedicated onboarding for NJTA teams.
Per-project pricing tailored to your contract scope.
We'll reach out within 24 hours to schedule a walkthrough tailored to your project.
Automated Time Impact Analysis (TIA) — PMs type a plain-text delay note → the system drafts the fragnet and TIA narrative.
AACE-Compliant Cost Estimating — Deterministic and probabilistic estimates per AACE International 98R-18.
Multi-Project Portfolio Integration — Independent project schedules rolled into a master program view.
Portfolio Roll-Up + TIA Fragnet Workflow — Active-project schedule health on a single Newark/PANYNJ portfolio strip.
Bid Scheduling & Proposal Support — Rapid quantity extraction and high-level CPM logic for prospective bids.
Cross-Disciplinary Coordination & L10 Integration — Schedule deviations drop straight to the L10 scorecard.
Live availability calendar — synced with your WhatsApp agent in real time.
2-hour soft hold · payment link sent via WhatsApp · cancel free for 24h.
CAT 320 Excavator Rental Dubai · From AED 1,800/day · Live availability · Same-day delivery across UAE.
UAE-region hosting (AWS me-central-1 or equivalent). Database backups daily.
WhatsApp Business API approval: typically 5–10 business days through Meta's BSP. We handle the application.
Any message containing pricing negotiation, complaints, or unrecognised intent is silently forwarded to your sales WhatsApp.
Offline-captured photos queue in IndexedDB and sync when connectivity is restored.
Bulk approve correctly transitions all visible pending IDs — RE queue at /re-review.
Rejection requires a non-empty reason; reason is stored in reject_reason and auto-posted as a comment.
